scoreboard_title: Timephoria and ESQA took TikTok reach; Hanasui's Instagram volume slipped
movers_title: Two TikTok gains and one Instagram drop

drivers.title: A wedding-prep story made ESQA's reach earned
drivers.why: @dyahcoppen's wedding-prep post drew 2.6M views, 50% of ESQA's TikTok week, at 7.2% engagement. Brand accounts fell from 84% of views to 15%, and engagement rose from 0.7% to 6.4%.
drivers.attention_to_action: The story post carried a cart, but overall cart share fell from 77% to 61%: one earned story, not a sales wave.

drivers.title: Timephoria turned its lip stain into a creator wave
drivers.why: 356 creators posted, up from 263, and 67 of them used #timephorialipstain, a tag no other brand used. The biggest post was a 5.4M-view concealer showcase, 51% of the week's views.
drivers.attention_to_action: This wave sold: cart posts rose from 48% to 64%, and the top cart product was the lip and cheek tint.

drivers.title: Hanasui's Instagram volume slipped; its Next Level line held on
drivers.why: Posts fell from 111 to 78 and creators from 95 to 62, below Hanasui's 8-week range. Reviews rose to 22% of posts, led by the @nextlevelmakeup.id account's 583K-view tint post.
drivers.attention_to_action: Instagram carries no cart signal here, so the drop is awareness lost. Watch whether TikTok, where Hanasui's posts held, picks up the slack.

actions.title: Turn the clippers into a programme
actions.detail: Nine clipper accounts drew 5.4M views, 12% of Paragon's week, at a 3K median against 546 for other posts. Brief them with one tag and the product on screen, and pay on views for a month.

actions.title: Run one seeding tag per hero product
actions.detail: Glad2Glow's #rekomendasisettingspray put 84 accounts behind one product for 24.2M views, 19% of its week. Give Make Over's setting spray the same: one tag and one-post briefs, before 7.7.

actions.title: Scale #gelatocleanser while it is working
actions.detail: #gelatocleanser already has 101 accounts and 137 posts for 2.9M views. Add cart links to every post and brief Mid-tier creators, who earn an 8K median per post against 583 for Nano.

actions.title: Answer Timephoria's lip stain wave on TikTok
actions.detail: Timephoria's #timephorialipstain reached 67 creators and its cart posts rose from 48% to 64%. Put Wardah and Make Over lip creators on TikTok with cart links before payday.

actions.title: Pilot story-led creator posts
actions.detail: One wedding-prep story by @dyahcoppen drew 2.6M views, 50% of ESQA's week, at 7.2% engagement. Pilot three story-led posts for Emina and compare them against showcase posts.

portfolio_note: Putri's Instagram posts rose from 11 to 79, and Paragon's Instagram posts rose to 1,384.

tiers.title: Hanasui's Micro creators carried 80% of its creator views
tiers.takeaway: Paragon's Mega posts are 1% of its creator posts but 27% of views; Glad2Glow gets 53% of views from Nano, 596 posts.

products.title: Glad2Glow's skin tint and setting spray took the week's views
products.takeaway: Glad2Glow's 119 skin tint posts drew 31.7M views and 93 setting posts 23.4M; Paragon's 317 cushion posts drew 10.7M.

posting.title: Glad2Glow landed 38% of its views on one day
posting.takeaway: Glad2Glow's peak day carried 27% of its posts and 38% of its views; Paragon spread evenly, 18% of posts and 14% of views on its peak.

closeups.next: #rekomendasisettingspray reached 84 accounts for 24.2M views; watch whether skin tint gets its own tag next.

closeups.next: Views fell to 32.2M with serum still leading at 7.3M; watch for its next launch push before 7.7.

patterns.takeaway: Nine clipper accounts posted 18 clips for 5.4M views at a 3K median, against 546 for other posts; Glad2Glow's #rekomendasisettingspray drew 24.2M from 84 accounts.
